raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to scroll far enough down the Wikipedia page to view the complete list of studio albums. The page displayed albums from 1962 to 1970 in the viewport, and the agent incorrectly assumed this was the complete list or that no albums existed in the target period (2000-2009). In reality, Mercedes Sosa released three studio albums between 2000 and 2009 (*Acústico*, *Corazón Libre*, and *Cantora*), which are listed further down on the page. The agent prematurely concluded the search without verifying the existence of albums in the later years of her career.
